definition: A non-linear function applied to a neuron's output that allows neural networks to model complex, non-linear relationships.
details: Without activation functions, stacking layers would collapse into a single linear transformation. Common examples include ReLU, GELU, sigmoid, and tanh.
story: Think of an orchestra warming up: no single instrument carries the piece, but together they make the sound. Boil it down and it is this: A non-linear function applied to a neuron's output that allows neural networks to model complex, non-linear relationships. Here is why it matters: Without activation functions, stacking layers would collapse into a single linear transformation. The shape of the machine is half the idea. That blueprint is Activation Function.
